syllabus_topics: Calculation of AC circuits using SKM (Phasors) methode. 3-phase power calculation and measurement.
Magnetic materials and Magnetic circuits. DC and AC electromagnets.
Transformer, principle, theory, equivalent circuit, phasor diagram, instrument transformer design.
Transformer: Open-circuit test, Short-circuit test; drop of voltage by loading. 3-phase transformer, hour angle. Special transformers.
Asynchronous motor, principle, construction, operating parameters.
As. Motor - theory, equivalent circuit, losses - subdivision.
Speed-torque characteristic. Circle diagram. Single-phase as. motor
Asynchronous motor - starting, speed control.
Synchronous machine, generator, motor, reluctance and stepper motors
DC-machines, principle, theory, equivalent circuit, fundamental equations.
DC - separately excited; (- shunt; - series) motor, speed - torque characteristic, starting.
Ward-Leonard system, speed controlling of DC-motors, Single-phase commutator motor.

Low-voltage power network.
Group subdivision, repetition of safety work rules. Calculations: 3-phase AC-circuits and 3-phase power. Measuring Instruments.
3-phase power measurement: 3 Wattmeter method; artificial connections - 1 W-method, 2 W- (Aron) method; reactive power and power factor; non-harmonic waveforms measurement.
Magnetic circuits measurement, electromagnet characteristic measurement, magnetic circuit calculation.
Power semiconductors, steady-state characteristics, cooling. Cooling calculation and verification.
1-phase transformer: Open-circuit test, Short-circuit test; loading characteristic. Examples, transformer design. Movie: Transformers production.
Asynchronous motor, terminals box, stator resistors measurement. No-load test, Locked-rotor test. Movie: As. Motors production.
As. Motor - frequency and voltage control; single phase power supply. Examples of As. Motor-drives.
As. Motor (Single phase, 3-phase) - loading test. Circle diagram. Examples Performance of As. Motor-drives.
Contactors automation. // Synchronous machine - No-load test, Short-circuit test, Synchronising.
Waveforms of characteristic quantities in the chopper connection with DC-motor (duty factor dependence). Examples Performance of DC machine - drives.
Control characteristics of DC-motor (No-load test), V-A characteristic of DC - motor-operated (and generator-operated) state. Magnetic neutral plane setting. Movie: DC-machines.
Contactors automation. // Synchronous machine - No-load test, Short-circuit test, Synchronising.
DC-machines - loading test, speed-torque characteristics of DC -separately excited.(-series) motor. AC-commutator motor measurement.
Assessment.
